Question and answer text in `data/video-qa.jsonl` remains copyright its respective Stack Overflow
contributors. Each post is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike version in
its corresponding `sources.jsonl` record:

- [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)
- [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)
- [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

The dataset transformation is described in each record. Reuse of the copied corpus must preserve
appropriate attribution, the applicable license link, modification notices, and ShareAlike terms.

MpVFX-owned test harnesses and behavior contracts outside this directory are not part of the corpus
license merely because they cite a post ID or implement an independently stated engineering fact.
Any test that reproduces protectable post expression must be marked and handled under the relevant
post license.
